package.description: Open-source, local-first conversational AI video editor with a professional multi-track timeline, Agent Skills, MCP integration, and Remotion rendering.

en-US.description: Open-source, local-first conversational AI video editor with a professional multi-track timeline, Agent Skills, MCP integration, and Remotion rendering.
en-US.longDescription: OpenChatCut is an open-source ChatCut alternative: a video editor that brings conversational agents and professional timeline editing into the same workspace. Every edit is written to real tracks, clips, transitions, captions, effects, and media inside the project, so you can keep editing manually, undo or redo changes, save versions, or hand the project to another agent. It features an agent-native design where the built-in agent and external MCP agents share the same editing tools, a real multi-track timeline with transitions, effects, LUTs, zooms, and keyframes, transcript-driven editing with word-level transcription and text-based cuts, image/video/speech/music generation, motion graphics with WebGL, visual geometry with in-browser person segmentation and face-safe zones, and production-ready exports to MP4, audio, captions, FCPXML, and complete project data. Projects and media stay on your machine by default.
en-US.name: OpenChatCut

zh-CN.description: 开源 ChatCut 替代 · Agent-native · local-first AI 视频编辑器。
zh-CN.longDescription: OpenChatCut 是开源的 ChatCut 替代品：把对话式 Agent 与专业时间线剪辑放进同一个工作区。每一次编辑都会写入工程中真实存在的轨道、片段、转场、字幕、特效与媒体，你可以继续手动剪辑、撤销或重做、保存版本，或把工程交给另一个 Agent。它支持 Agent-native 设计（内置 Agent 与外部 MCP Agent 共享同一套剪辑工具）、多轨时间线与转场特效、基于转录的剪辑（逐词转录、文本剪辑、停顿处理、发言人识别与字幕联动）、图像 / 视频 / 语音 / 音乐生成、WebGL 动态图形、浏览器内人像分割与人物安全区，以及 MP4、音频、字幕、FCPXML 与完整工程数据的生产级导出。工程与媒体默认保存在本机。
